hero.title: Strengthening digital maturity
hero.lead: Children are growing up in a digital world that brings both opportunities and challenges. We want to create a space that fosters orientation, reflection, and digital maturity.

statement.text: Warnings alone are not enough. Children need orientation, language, and safe spaces to think in order to truly understand digital situations.

vision.title: Kids surf smart.
vision.copy: We envision a society in which young people can assess digital information, weigh perspectives, and make their own decisions. For us, digital empowerment means more than safety. It begins where children understand connections, take responsibility, and learn to deal with complexity.

mission.title: Empowering children in the digital world
mission.copy: We support children in not just experiencing digital situations, but understanding them consciously. Amy Surfwing creates a narrative space for reflection where perspectives become visible, thoughts grow, and independent decisions can emerge.

motivation.title: How it all began
motivation.copy1: Amy Surfwing grew out of many conversations between us – about our children, the internet, and how they learn to navigate it. It quickly became clear: naming digital risks alone is not enough. Children need something that truly reaches them – a format that sparks curiosity and strengthens them step by step.
motivation.copy2: Conversations remain the most important part. That is why this blog is for parents who stand by their children as they navigate the digital world.

0.title: Digital life is already part of children’s everyday reality
0.body: Children engage in digital spaces from an early age. What they need there are not just restrictions, but language, orientation, and safe spaces for thinking.

1.title: Media education that takes children seriously
1.body: Amy Surfwing combines story, reflection, and everyday situations into a format that is understandable, motivating, and responsibly designed.

items.0: Taking children seriously means shaping the future responsibly.
items.1: Self-reflection and small impulses can create a big impact.
items.2: Every question is allowed – and every answer is a starting point for further thinking.
items.3: We combine empathy, innovation, and a joy of learning.

method.title: Narrative instead of rulebooks
method.copy1: Digital topics are not taught as theory, but made tangible through storytelling. Short chat-based scenes lead into concrete decision-making moments.
method.copy2: Amy guides children with targeted reflection questions. The focus is on reasoning, perspectives, and weighing consequences – not on right or wrong answers.

values.title: What we stand for
values.intro: Our values shape our content, tone, and design – and how we think about children, learning, and digital education.

1.title: Impact

2.title: Self-determination

3.body: Every thought matters, and new perspectives enrich us.

glimpses.lead: We’re building Amy Surfwing with purpose — because we believe children deserve better.

brand.title: What AYM stands for
brand.aria: Open section: What AYM stands for
brand.copy1: AYM stands for “Amplify Your Mind”: giving young people the space to develop and unfold their own perspective on the world.
brand.copy2: “Amplify” means to strengthen, make heard, and think bigger. We believe children start with creativity, curiosity, and judgment – AYM VISION helps to further develop exactly these abilities.

whyAmy.title: Why our owl Amy
whyAmy.aria: Open section: Why our owl Amy
whyAmy.copy: Amy is our friendly, wise owl – and the face of AYM VISION. She meets children at eye level, explains things clearly, and encourages them to think along. Amy stands for curiosity, reflection, and the courage to form one’s own perspective.

team.title: Who is behind it
team.lead: We are sisters and mothers. It all started with our four children. We want every child to grow up safely in the digital world.

age.question: What age is Amy Surfwing suitable for?
age.answer: Amy Surfwing is aimed at children from age 9. The topics and language are tailored to this age group — challenging enough to engage, but not overwhelming.

topics.question: What topics does Amy Surfwing cover?
topics.answer: The topics come directly from children's digital everyday lives: cyberbullying, peer pressure, fake news, artificial intelligence, privacy, and manipulated images — embedded in an ongoing chat story.
topics.link: All topics on the parents page →

social.question: Can my child interact with other children?
social.answer: No. Amy Surfwing is deliberately not a social network. Children read and experience the story world on their own. Content is not shared publicly, there are no chats with other users, and no visible profiles.

costs.question: What does Amy Surfwing cost?
costs.answer: The first three chapters are free to play, no commitment required. Season 1 is available from 15 October as a bundle for €24 (incl. VAT). Packages for siblings, school classes, or groups are available on request.

storage.question: What happens to my child's data?
storage.answer: Profiles are created locally on the device — no email or password needed. Game progress, stickers, diary entries, and settings remain exclusively on this device. When purchasing or redeeming a voucher, an anonymous identifier is sent to our server to verify the purchase status. This identifier contains no personal data and cannot be traced back to your child. Data is not shared with third parties.

deviceSwitch.question: What happens if I switch devices or clear storage?
deviceSwitch.answer1: Everything is stored locally and will be permanently lost without a backup. In the
deviceSwitch.answer3: you can create a progress link (transfers progress, stickers, and coins — no chat history) or download a full backup file that also includes chat history. Purchases are restored separately using the 24 security words.

iosStorage.question: What happens if I don't use the app for a while?
iosStorage.answer: On iPhone and iPad, iOS automatically deletes data from installed web apps after approximately 7 days of inactivity. Regularly create a progress link or backup file in the parent area to protect your game progress.

purchaseRestore.intro: During setup you receive 24 personal words — these are your personal access key. You can copy them or send them to yourself via 'Send to myself by email'. Here's how to restore on a new device:
purchaseRestore.step2: Tap 'Restore access' on the start screen
purchaseRestore.step4: Set a new parent password — access restored ✓

multiProfile.question: What happens if we create multiple profiles as a family?
multiProfile.answer: Each child has their own profile with their own security words, their own learning progress, and their own purchase. One purchase applies per profile. Packages for families with multiple children are available on request.

progressTransfer.question: How do I transfer game progress to another device?
progressTransfer.answer3: there are two options: a progress link for progress, stickers, and coins (no chat history) — or a full backup file including chat history. On the new device, first enter the 24 security words, then import the link or backup file.
